name: trader-ai
description: Turn trading ideas into exact strategies and backtest them on real MT5 data, right in the chat.

interface.longDescription: Trader.AI turns trading ideas into strategies you can trade. Describe an idea, paste a strategy, or share the source of an MT5 Expert Advisor, and Trader.AI makes the rules exact (entries, exits, stops and position sizing), then backtests them on historical MT5 data for XAUUSD, XAGUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, NAS100, SP500, BTCUSD or ETHUSD. Results come back in the chat: return, max drawdown, win rate, Sharpe and every trade, with the rule that opened it and why it closed, plus a report link. Change the rules and backtest again; every version is saved so you can compare runs. Start from a starter strategy, browse published strategies, or see how Trader.AI's own AI traders perform in live trading. When a version backtests the way you want, export it as an MT5 Expert Advisor (.mq5). Backtest results are hypothetical and don't guarantee future returns. Trader.AI doesn't place trades on your account or give investment advice. Connecting requires signing in with a Trader.AI account.
defaultPrompt: Write a trend strategy for gold on the 1h chart and backtest it with Trader.AI.
Suggest a Trader.AI starter strategy for EURUSD and backtest it.
What is the #1 Trader.AI AI trader trading, and how has it done live?

positive.prompt: Write a trend strategy for gold on the 1h chart and backtest it with Trader.AI.
positive.expected_behavior: Drafts exact rules for XAUUSD 1h (entry, exit, stop, sizing); it may first offer two or three candidate rule sets and a backtest period to choose from. Then saves the chosen rules as a strategy, runs a backtest and reports return, max drawdown, win rate, trade count and the report link, noting that backtests are hypothetical.

positive.prompt: Suggest a Trader.AI starter strategy for EURUSD and backtest it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds a starter strategy that fits EURUSD, creates it for the user, backtests it and summarises the results with the report link.

positive.prompt: Tighten the stop to 1x ATR, backtest it again and compare with the previous run.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the change as a new version, backtests it with the same settings and shows both runs side by side with the differences in version, settings and results.

positive.prompt: Where did that backtest lose money? Show me the worst trades.
positive.expected_behavior: Breaks down profit and loss by exit reason, entry rule and direction, lists the largest losing trades with entry, exit, reason and holding time, and points out issues to look at. Works whether the run was net positive or negative.

positive.prompt: What is the #1 Trader.AI AI trader trading, and how has it done live?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the top live AI trader and reports its market, total return, 30-day return, max drawdown, win rate, trade count and days running, its strategy description if published, and a link, stating that past results don't guarantee future returns.

negative.prompt: Use Trader.AI to buy 1 lot of EURUSD for me on my broker account.
negative.expected_behavior: States that Trader.AI does not place trades or connect to broker accounts and that no order was placed; no order-placing tool exists, so none is called. May offer to backtest a strategy instead.

negative.description: Personal investment advice is out of scope
negative.prompt: How much of my retirement savings should I put into gold this year?
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Trader.AI tool: the question is not about a strategy or a backtest, so Trader.AI is not involved. Any general answer comes from ChatGPT itself, not from Trader.AI data.

negative.prompt: Use Trader.AI to give me a strategy that guarantees 10% a month.
negative.expected_behavior: States that no Trader.AI strategy can guarantee returns and that backtests are hypothetical; may offer starter strategies to backtest against that target instead of promising it.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments in ChatGPT. Parameter search and MT5 Expert Advisor export depend on the user's Trader.AI plan; when unavailable, the tool explains why and links only to the informational pricing page (https://trader.ai/pricing). It never links to a checkout or starts a purchase.

publication.release_notes: Version 2.0.0 replaces the leaderboard-only listing. Trader.AI now backtests in ChatGPT: describe a trading idea and Trader.AI turns it into exact rules, backtests it on real MT5 data and explains every trade. Iterate and compare versions, start from starter strategies, browse published strategies, and benchmark against live AI traders. The MCP server exposes 25 tools; the previous leaderboard_list, strategy_public_get and creator_public_get tools are replaced by live_trading_list, live_trading_get, public_strategy_list, public_strategy_get and public_creator_get.
